A small, decorative, somewhat weighty object placed on one or more pieces of paper to keep them from fluttering away.
(uncountable) Routine work involving written documents.
Torn-up paper and other possible materials mixed with paste or glue used to create, when the mass is dried, a durable sculptural object.
A broad form of fettuccine, or a narrow form of lasagne, traditionally eaten with a meat sauce (especially one made with hare).
Of a bright reddish orange colour, like that of the dried paprika.
A bright reddish orange colour resembling that of the ground spice.
(dermatology) A small, inflammatory, irritated spot on the skin, similar in appearance to a pimple, but not containing pus.
The study of papyrus, particularly the branch of archeology concerning ancient texts written on papyrus.
(usually, uncountable) A plant (Cyperus papyrus) in the sedge family, native to the Nile river valley, paper reed.
(usually, uncountable) A material similar to paper made from the papyrus plant.
above, over
A short narrative illustrating a lesson (usually religious/moral) by comparison or analogy.

(geometry) The conic section formed by the intersection of a cone with a plane parallel to a tangent plane to the cone; the locus of points equidistant from a fixed point (the focus) and line (the directrix).
(aviation) A device, generally constructed from fabric, that is designed to employ air resistance to control the fall of an object or person, causing them to float instead of falling.
The sport or activity of jumping with a parachute.
A public procession, especially one commemorating a holiday or special event or (dated) in protest.

sense.def: (organic compound) 1,4-dichlorobenzene, an organic compound used as a pesticide (i.e., mothballs) and a deodorant.
An example serving as the model for such a pattern; an exceptionally good or prototypical example of a pattern or group.
(linguistics) A set of all forms which contain a common element, especially the set of all inflectional forms of a word or a particular grammatical category.

(figuratively) A very pleasant place, such as a place full of lush vegetation.
(slang) The upper gallery in a theatre.
An apparently self-contradictory statement, which can only be true if it is false, and vice versa.
A person or thing having contradictory properties.

Having self-contradictory properties.
(petrochemistry, organic compound) Any member of the alkane hydrocarbons.
A waxy white solid hydrocarbon mixture used to make candles, wax paper, lubricants, and sealing materials.
The complete equipment used for paragliding, consisting of a paraglider wing and a harness.
The sport of gliding with a paraglider.
A passage in text that starts on a new line, the first line sometimes being indented, and usually marks a change of topic.
(originally) A mark or note set in the margin to call attention to something in the text, such as a change of subject.
(anatomy) A section of the cerebral cortex that surrounds the hippocampus and which is the lower part of the fornicate gyrus.
Any of various species of small parrot primarily of tropical regions. [from 16th c.]
An apparent shift in the position of two stationary objects relative to each other as viewed by an observer, due to a change in observer position.
Equally distant from one another at all points.
(geography) A line of latitude.

(military) One of a series of long trenches constructed before a besieged fortress, by the besieging force, as a cover for troops supporting the attacking batteries. They are roughly parallel to the line of outer defenses of the fortress.
The action of parking a vehicle with its side parallel to the curb or the side of the road and facing in the direction of the traffic in the adjacent lane.
(sciences, scifi, cosmology) A universe that exists separately alongside another universe, as part of a multiverse.
(geometry) A solid figure, having six faces, all parallelograms, all opposite faces being similar and parallel.
(geometry) A convex quadrilateral in which each pair of opposite edges are parallel and of equal length.
(pathology) The complete loss of voluntary control of part of a person's body, such as one or more limbs.
(transitive) To afflict with paralysis.
An oval-shaped protozoan organism of the genus Paramecium.

A person trained to medically stabilize people through various interventions for victims of trauma or medical events outside of a hospital setting and prepare them for transport to a medical facility.
A value kept constant during an experiment, equation, calculation, or similar, but varied over other versions of the experiment, equation, calculation, etc.
(programming) An input variable of a function definition, that gets an actual value (argument) at execution time.
(Buddhism) perfection or culmination of certain virtues
(somewhat, dated) An illicit lover, either male or female.

The obsolete name for a psychotic disorder, now called delusional disorder, often (in one of six subtypes) characterized by delusions of persecution and a perceived threat against the individual affected with the disorder, and often associated with false accusations and a general mistrust of others
Of, related to, or suffering from clinical paranoia.

cit.quote: 妄想性パーソナリティ障害

sense.def: (psychiatry) A mental disorder characterized by paranoia and a pervasive, long-standing suspiciousness and generalized mistrust of others.
(psychiatry) A form of schizophrenia that is accompanied by delusions, either of persecution, grandeur or jealousy.

(sexology) Sexual arousal in response to sexual objects or situations which may interfere with the capacity for reciprocal affectionate sexual activity or lead to clinically significant distress or impairment (e.g. are obligatory, require participation of unconsenting individuals, lead to legal issues).
A medical condition where the foreskin becomes trapped behind the glans.

(ambitransitive) To restate something as, or to compose a paraphrase. To repeat a written or spoken phrase/quote using different words, often in a simpler and shorter form, or sometimes in a humorous context.
(pathology) A condition where the lower half of a patient's body is paralyzed and cannot move.
The study of alleged paranormal phenomena; psychic or occult phenomena, such as telepathy and ghosts.

(biology) An organism that lives on or in another organism of a different species, deriving benefit from living on or in that other organism, while not contributing towards that other organism sufficiently to cover the cost to that other organism.
The study of parasites.
A small light umbrella used as protection from the sun.
(neuroanatomy) One of the divisions of the autonomic nervous system, based between the brain and the spinal cord, that slows the heart and relaxes muscles.
(linguistics) A term (word or phrase) which is parasynonymous with others, but not necessarily considered a synonym.
an Indian bread with a texture somewhat resembling puff pastry; sometimes stuffed with vegetables etc.
(anatomy) Any one of four endocrine glands situated in the neck, usually within a thyroid gland, which produce parathyroid hormone.
(American) An auxiliary transit service without fixed routes or schedules, usually serving the disabled on demand. [From 1972.]
A type of soldier who is trained to enter combat zones by parachuting from aircraft.
A package wrapped for shipment.
A division of land bought and sold as a unit.
A document made on such material.
Stiff paper imitating that material.
Cellulose-based paper used in baking as a disposable nonstick surface.
Often used when someone does not understand what another person says.
Forgiveness for an offence.
(idiomatic) Sorry; said as an apology.

cit.quote: 下品な言い方で恐縮だけど

sense.def: (intransitive, idiomatic, often, humorous) To excuse the speaker's frankness of expression or profanity.
(often in the plural) A person who has had a baby; this person in relation to their child or children.
The source or origin of something. [from 16th c.]
(biology) An organism from which a plant or animal is immediately biologically descended. [from 17th c.]
(computing) The object from which a child or derived object is descended; a node superior to another node. [from 20th c.]
A leave of absence from a job for a parent to take care of a baby.
Either of a pair of brackets, especially (mainly US) round brackets, ( and ) (used to enclose parenthetical material in a text).
A wraparound garment, worn by men or women, similar to a Malaysian sarong.
An American parfait, a layered dessert often consisting of fruit, ice cream, pastries, whipped topping, etc. and served in a glass, often a parfait glass.
(anatomy) One of the four major divisions of the cerebrum of the brain.
(Buddhism) The final release from rebirth.
(Roman Catholicism, Anglican, Lutheranism, Eastern Orthodox) An administrative part of a diocese that has its own church.

(US) An ecclesiastical society, usually not bounded by territorial limits, but composed of those persons who choose to unite under the charge of a particular priest, clergyman, or minister; also, loosely, the territory in which the members of a congregation live.
A civil subdivision of a British county, often corresponding to an earlier ecclesiastical parish.
An area of land set aside for environment preservation or recreation.
A tract of ground kept in its natural state, about or adjacent to a residence, such as for the preservation of game, for walking, riding, or the like.
(transitive) To bring (something such as a vehicle) to a halt or store in a specified place.
(clothing) A long jacket with a hood which protects the wearer against rain and wind.
The action of the verb to park.
Space in which to park a car or other vehicle, such as a parking lot or curbside parking.
A brake in a vehicle that can be set to avoid the vehicle rolling down a hill or being pushed away.
(North America, Philippines, Malaysia) A parking area, generally paved and open-air (sometimes with limited overhead covering), where automobiles may be left when not in use.
A device, located by a parking space, that collects payment in exchange for the right to park a vehicle for a specified time.

(sport) An athletic discipline, in which practitioners traverse any environment in the most efficient way possible using their physical abilities, and which commonly involves running, jumping, vaulting, rolling, flipping, and other similar physical movements.
(dated) A path, carriage-way, or road through a park or a landscaped right of way.

In many countries, the legislative branch of government, a deliberative assembly or set of assemblies whose elected or appointed members meet to debate the major political issues of the day, make, amend, and repeal laws, authorize the executive branch of government to collect and spend money, and in some cases exercise judicial powers; a legislature. [from 14th c.]

A particular assembly of the members of such a legislature, as convened for a specific purpose or period of time (commonly designated with an ordinal number – for example, first parliament or 12th parliament – or a descriptive adjective – for example, Long Parliament, Short Parliament and Rump Parliament). [from 14th c.]
(Commonwealth) A member of a parliament, congress or an elected national legislative body of another name.
(dated, except in, Mid-Atlantic US) The living room of a house, or a room for entertaining guests; a room for talking; a sitting-room or drawing room.
A hard, full-fat Italian cheese from Parma.
(derogatory) Characterized by an unsophisticated focus on local concerns to the exclusion of wider contexts; elementary in scope or outlook.
A work or performance that imitates another work or performance with ridicule or irony.
(countable, archaic) A popular maxim, adage, or proverb.

(with on) Originally, one's oath or word of honour, given as a condition of release from custody; now specifically, describing the release of a former prisoner under certain conditions, especially the promise of good behaviour. [from 17th c.]
Conditional release of a prisoner (now especially before the end of a custodial sentence), or the term or state of such release; the system governing such releases. [from 17th c.]
(rare) A near-homophone, a word that sounds like another word (some example pairs are cognate).
(pathology) A distorted sense of smell, often resulting in the apparent detection of non-existent smells which are mostly unpleasant.
(anatomy) Either of a pair of salivary glands located in front of and below each ear in humans.
A wooden floor made of wooden tiles or veneers arranged in a decorative geometrical pattern.
A kind of bird, many species of which are colorful and able to mimic human speech, of the order Psittaciformes or (narrowly) of the family Psittacidae.
Loxia pytyopsittacus, a small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae.
(computing, linguistics) An act of parsing; a parsing.

(linguistics, ambitransitive) To resolve (a sentence, etc.) into its elements, pointing out the several parts of speech, and their relation to each other by agreement or government; to analyze and describe grammatically. [from mid 16th c.]
(astronomy, metrology) .
A fictional language of snakes in the Harry Potter universe.
(computing) A computer program that parses.
Great reluctance to spend money unnecessarily.
(countable, uncountable) A bright green, biennial herb, Petroselinum crispum, having many cultivars.
(uncountable) The leaves of this plant used in Middle Eastern, European, and American cooking.
A biennial plant, Pastinaca sativa, related to the carrot.
The root of the parsnip, when used as a vegetable.
A section of a document.
A fraction of a whole.
Position or role (especially in a play).
(US) The dividing line formed by combing the hair in different directions.
(intransitive) To leave the company of.
(grammar) A linguistic category of words sharing syntactic or morphological behaviour and semantic properties, such as noun or verb.
For, during, or involving less than the normal time for some activity, especially the number of hours an employee works.
(formal) To take part in an activity; to participate. [with in]

(biology, countable, uncountable) (An instance of) reproduction by the development of a single gamete (an ovum or ovule) without fertilisation by a gamete of the opposite sex; compare monogenesis, metagenesis, and heterogamy.
Existing as a part or portion; incomplete.
(mathematics) Of or relating to a partial derivative or partial differential.
Biased in favor of a person, side, or point of view, especially when dealing with a competition or dispute.
(calculus) A differential equation that involves the partial derivatives of a function of several variables.

(set theory, order theory) (informal) An ordering of the elements of a collection that behaves like that of the natural numbers by size, except that some elements may not be comparable (if all elements are comparable, it is called a total order); (formal) a binary relation that is reflexive, antisymmetric, and transitive.
To a partial degree or extent, incompletely.
(set theory, order theory, loosely) A set that has a given, elsewhere specified partial order.
One who participates.
(intransitive) To join in, to take part, to involve oneself (in something). [from 16th c.]
The act of participating, of taking part in something.

(grammar) A form of a verb that may function as an adjective, noun or adverb. English has two types of participles: the present participle and the past participle. In other languages, there are others, such as future, perfect, and future perfect participles.
A very small piece of matter, a fragment; especially, the smallest possible part of something. [from 14th c.]
(physics) Any of various physical objects making up the constituent parts of an atom; an elementary particle or subatomic particle. [from 19th c.]

(grammar) A part of speech that has no inherent lexical definition but must be associated with another word to impart meaning, often a grammatical category: for example, the English word to in a full infinitive phrase (to eat) or O in a vocative phrase (O Canada), or as a discourse marker (mmm).
A device that accelerates electrically charged particles to extremely high speeds, for the purpose of inducing high energy reactions or producing high energy radiation.
The physics of subatomic particles
Specialised; characteristic of a specific person or thing.
Any solid or liquid in a finely subdivided state, especially when considered as an atmospheric pollutant.
A farewell, the act of departing politely.
An action which divides a thing into parts, or separates one thing from another.
That which divides or separates; that by which different things, or distinct parts of the same thing, are separated; boundary; dividing line or space.
(computing) A division of a data stream, such as a messaging queue or topic (often representing a unit of parallelism, and of fault tolerance).
(set theory) A collection of non-empty, disjoint subsets of a set whose union is the set itself (i.e. all elements of the set are contained in exactly one of the subsets).
A vertical structure that divides a room.
(computing) A section of a hard disk separately formatted.
In part, or to some degree, but not completely.
Someone with whom one plays on the same side in a game, such as card games or doubles tennis.
(nautical) One of the pieces of wood comprising the framework which strengthens the deck of a wooden ship around the holes through which the mast and other fittings pass.
(Jamaica) A group financial arrangement in which each member contributes a set amount of money over a set period.
A spouse or other person with whom one shares a domestic, romantic or sexual bond.
Someone who is associated with another in a common activity or interest.
An association of two or more people to conduct a business
(ornithology) Any bird of a number of genera in the family Phasianidae, notably in the genera Perdix and Alectoris.
The act of giving birth; childbirth.
A gathering of acquaintances so that one of them may offer items for sale to the rest of them.
A social gathering, usually of invited guests, which typically involves eating, drinking, and entertainment and often held to celebrate a particular occasion. [from 1700s]
(idiomatic) A person known for frequent, enthusiastic attendance at parties, especially one whose partying behavior is exuberant or excessive.
A woman's dress that is too elegant, revealing, dressy or impractical for normal wear.
A game played at a party, such as musical chairs or charades.
(video game genre) A multiplayer game, usually consisting of a series of short minigames, that can be easily played in a social setting.
(British) a short radio or television broadcast made by a political party

A person who has risen, climbed up, or has been promoted to a higher social class, especially through acquisition of wealth, privileges, or political authority but has not gained social acceptance by those within that new class.
In the International System of Units, the derived unit of pressure and stress; one newton per square metre. Symbol: Pa.
(historical) A high-ranking Turkish military officer, especially as a commander or regional governor; the highest honorary title during the Ottoman Empire.
A traditional Eastern Orthodox Easter dessert, made from curd.
A fast Spanish ballroom dance in double time.
An opening, road, or track, available for passing; especially, one through or over some dangerous or otherwise impracticable barrier such as a mountain range; a passageway; a defile; a ford.
(fencing) A thrust or push; an attempt to stab or strike an adversary.
A document granting permission to pass or to go and come; a passport; a ticket permitting free transit or admission
The state of things; condition; predicament; impasse.
(cookery) The area in a restaurant kitchen where the finished dishes are passed from the chefs to the waiting staff.
(transitive) To go past, by, over, or through; to proceed from one side to the other of; to move past.

(transitive) To cause to advance by stages of progress; to carry on with success through an ordeal, examination, or action; specifically, to give legal or official sanction to; to ratify; to enact; to approve as valid and just.
(intransitive, legal) To be conveyed or transferred by will, deed, or other instrument of conveyance.
(transitive) To allow to go by without noticing; to omit attention to; to take no note of; to disregard.
(archaic, literary) To disappear; to cease to be; to be no more.
(transitive) To convey or communicate.

cit.quote: 蜥蜴の尻尾切りにする

sense.def: (idiomatic, informal) To transfer responsibility or blame from oneself onto another; to absolve oneself of concern for a given matter by claiming to lack authority or jurisdiction.
(music genre) A form of historical Spanish or Italian dance characterised by a serious nature, triple metre, and use of a ground bass.
The official approval of a bill or act by a parliament. [from 17th c.]
A covered walkway, between rooms or buildings.
(baseball) A play where the catcher fails to stop a normally playable pitch and a runner advances.
One who rides or travels in a vehicle, but who does not operate it and is not a member of the crew.
(vehicle) A motor vehicle designed to carry (a few) passengers; a motorcar.
A bird of the extinct species †Ectopistes migratorius, formerly endemic to North America.
A ship whose primary function is to carry passengers.
A person who is passing by (that is, walking past).
(rare) That occurs at various places throughout a text
Any great, strong, powerful emotion, especially romantic love or extreme hate.
An object of passionate or romantic love or strong romantic interest.
(Christianity, usually capitalized) The suffering of Jesus leading up to and during his crucifixion.
(uncountable) The flesh of the edible fruit.
Fired with intense feeling.
Being subjected to an action without producing a reaction.
(grammar) Being in the passive voice.
A form of liquid crystal display in which the pixels must maintain their state without active driving circuitry until they are next refreshed, contrasted with active matrix.

(grammar) A participle indicating an ongoing or completed action or state in the passive voice, where a noun modified by the participle is taken to represent the patient of the action denoted by the verb.
The involuntary inhalation of tobacco smoke by a non-smoker due to the proximity to a smoker.
(grammar) The form of a transitive verb in which its subject receives the action.
An official document normally used for international journeys, which proves the identity and nationality of the person for whom it was issued.
(military, security) A word relayed to a person to gain admittance to a place or to gain access to information.

(computing, cryptography) A string of characters used to log in to a computer or network, to access a level in a video game, and so on; archetypally a word#Noun but nowadays often an alphanumeric#Adjective string or a phrase#Noun.
The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.
(grammar) The past tense.
(grammar) A tense used to describe actions and states continued in the past.

(grammar) A tense used in some languages (such as French and Italian) in narrative, and in spoken language primarily when reading narrative or in storytelling, for completed actions in the past or in speaking of the deceased.
A previously lived life in a different body, according to theories of reincarnation.
(grammar) A participle indicating a completed action or state.

(grammar) A grammatical form (often a verb form) that refers to an event, transaction, occurrence, or object that happened (or had happened), or existed, at some time before now (the applicable reference time).
(uncountable) Dough made from wheat and water and sometimes mixed with egg and formed into various shapes; often sold in dried form and typically boiled for eating.

cit.quote: パスタ・エ・ファジョーリ

sense.def: An Italian soup made with pasta and cannellini beans.
A salad prepared with one or more types of pasta, almost always chilled, and most often tossed in a vinegar, oil, or mayonnaise-based dressing.
Any of several subdued tints of colors, usually associated with pink, peach, yellow, green, blue, and lavender.
A crayon made from such a paste.

cit.quote: パスチャライゼーション

sense.def: (British spelling) Heat-treatment of a perishable food to destroy heat-sensitive vegetative cells followed by immediate cooling to limit growth of the surviving cells and germination of spores.
(transitive) To heat food for the purpose of killing harmful organisms such as bacteria, viruses, protozoa, molds, and yeasts.
A work of art, drama, literature, music, or architecture that imitates the work of a previous artist, usually in a positive or neutral way.
An item worn (often by strippers) to conceal one's nipples.
A Neapolitan tart made from wheat, eggs, and ricotta, traditionally eaten at Easter.
An often round and somewhat flat flavoured candy or sweet.
Something which amuses, and serves to make time pass agreeably.
(countable, Protestantism) A minister or priest in a church.
A seasoned smoked cut of beef, traditionally made from a navel cut.
(uncountable) The food group formed by the various kinds of pastries.
A flexible bag from which icing is forced through a small nozzle to make various designs of piping.
A baker who makes pastry products.
Land, specifically, an open field, on which livestock is kept for feeding.
(transitive) To move animals into a pasture.
To (gently) tap the flat of one's hand on a person or thing.
The monetary unit of Macau, equal to 100 avos.
(computing) A piece of data intended to modify a computer file by replacing a part of it.
The oil or perfume made from these plants.
Explicit and obvious.
(US, historical) A specific grant of ownership of a piece of real property; a land patent.
A declaration issued by a government agency that the inventor of a new invention has the sole privilege of making, selling, or using the claimed invention for a specified period.
To (successfully) register (a new invention) with a government agency to obtain the sole privilege of its manufacture, sale, and use for a specified period.

(patent law, informal, derogatory) A company, person, etc., that owns and enforces patents in an aggressive and opportunistic manner, often with no intention of producing, marketing, or promoting the subjects of the patents.
Of or pertaining to one's father, his genes, his relatives, or his side of a family.
A sister of someone’s father.
The wife of a sibling of someone’s father.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see paternal,‎ grandfather. (This entry is a translation hub.)
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see paternal,‎ grandmother. (This entry is a translation hub.)
A brother or brother-in-law of one's father. (This entry is a translation hub.)
(archaic) A patent medicine, so named because salesmen would pray the Lord's Prayer over it before selling it.
A course taken.
(computing) A human-readable specification for a location within a hierarchical or tree-like structure, such as a file system or as part of a URL.

(graph theory) A sequence of vertices from one vertex to another using the arcs (edges). A path does not visit the same vertex more than once (unless it is a closed path, where only the first and the last vertex are the same).
Arousing pity, sympathy, or compassion; exciting pathos.
Arousing scorn or contempt, often due to miserable inadequacy.
(pathology, immunology) An agent that can cause disease, especially an infectious microorganism, such as a bacterium, virus, protozoon or fungus.
(academic, _, medicine) The academic biomedical specialty that advances the aspects of the biomedical sciences that allow for those clinical applications and their advancements over time.
Pathosis: any deviation from a healthy or normal structure or function; abnormality; illness or malformation.
(pathology) The physiological processes associated with disease or injury.

The quality or property of anything which touches the feelings or excites emotions and passions, especially that which awakens tender emotions, such as pity, sorrow, and the like; contagious warmth of feeling, action, or expression; pathetic quality.
The quality of being patient.
Any of various card games that can be played by one person. Called solitaire in the US and Canada.
(of a person) Willing to wait if necessary; not losing one's temper while waiting.
A person or animal that receives health care from a doctor, nurse, dentist, allied health practitioner, or other person educated in health care.
The colour or incrustation which age and wear give to (mainly metallic) objects; especially, the green rust which covers works of art such as ancient bronzes, coins and medals.

(Christianity) The highest form of bishop, in the ancient world having authority over other bishops in the province but now generally as an honorary title; in Roman Catholicism, considered a bishop second only to the Pope in rank. [from 9th c.]
The male head of a household or nuclear family.
(anthropology, history) A social system in which the father is head of the household, having authority over women and children, and in which lineage is traced through the male line.
A person who loves and zealously supports and defends their country.
Inspired by or showing patriotism; done out of love of one's country; zealously and unselfishly devoted to the service of one's country
Love of one's country; devotion to the welfare of one's compatriots; passion which inspires one to serve one's country.
(military) A going of the rounds along the chain of sentinels and between the posts, by a guard, usually consisting of three or four men, to insure greater security from attacks on the outposts.
(military) A movement, by a small body of troops beyond the line of outposts, to explore the country and gain intelligence of the enemy's whereabouts.
(military) The guards who go the rounds for observation; a detachment whose duty it is to patrol.
Any perambulation of a particular line or district to guard it; also, the people thus guarding.
(intransitive) To go the rounds along a chain of sentinels; to traverse a police district or beat.
(transitive) To go the rounds of, as a sentry, guard, or policeman
The car in which law enforcement officers, such as police officers or park rangers, patrol an area.
One who protects or supports; a defender or advocate.
An influential, wealthy person who supported an artist, craftsman, a scholar or a noble.
(Christianity) A saint conceived as the patron (protector or supporter) of a particular place, group, person, or activity, for whom or for which his or her intercession is specially invoked.
(transitive) To act as a patron of; to defend, protect, or support.
(transitive) To make oneself a customer of a business, especially a regular customer.

(onomastics, by extension) A name acquired from the first name of one's father, grandfather or earlier (male) ancestor. Some cultures use a patronymic where other cultures use a surname or family name; other cultures (like Russia) use both a patronymic and a surname.
Something from which a copy is made; a model or outline. [from 14th c.]
A particular sequence of events, facts etc. which can be understood, used to predict the future, or seen to have a mathematical, geometric, statistical etc. relationship. [from 19th c.]
A design, motif or decoration, especially formed from regular repeated elements. [from 16th c.]
(US, Australia, New Zealand) A flattened portion of ground meat or a vegetarian equivalent, usually round but sometimes square in shape.
One who is extremely poor.
A temporary stop or rest; an intermission of action; interruption; suspension; cessation.
(intransitive) To hesitate; to hold back; to delay.
(transitive) To halt the play or playback of, temporarily, so that it can be resumed from the same point.
(British) To cover something with paving slabs.
(Canada, US) To cover with stone, concrete, blacktop or other solid covering, especially to aid travel.
An ornate tent.
A light roofed structure used as a shelter in a public place.
A structure, sometimes temporary, erected to house exhibits at a fair, etc.
A detached or semi-detached building at a hospital or other building complex.
(transitive) To put inside a pavilion.
(chiefly, Australia, and, New Zealand) A meringue dessert usually topped with fruit and cream. [From 1927.]
The soft foot of a mammal or other animal, generally a quadruped, that has claws or nails; comparable to a human hand or foot.
(transitive) Of an animal, to touch (something) with a paw.
(transitive, by extension) To clumsily dig (through something).
(New Zealand) An edible univalve mollusc of the genus Haliotis, having a shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

A pivoted catch designed to fall into a notch on a ratchet wheel so as to allow movement in only one direction (e.g. on a windlass or in a clock mechanism), or alternatively to move the wheel in one direction.
A similar device to prevent motion in other mechanisms besides ratchets.
(chess) The most numerous chess piece, or a similar piece in a similar game. In chess, each side starts with eight; moves are only forward, and attacks are only diagonally or en passant.
(idiomatic) A person being manipulated by another, being used to some end.
A person who makes monetary loans at interest, taking personal property as security – which may be sold if not redeemed.
The business premises of a pawnbroker; where loans are made, with personal property as security
The fruit of these trees.
(ambitransitive) To give money or other compensation to in exchange for goods or services.
A system whereby viewers pay to subscribe to specific broadcast television channels or programme typically used in cable television services
(idiomatic, intransitive) To attend; to be attentive; to focus one's attention.
(figuratively) To avenge, to exact revenge.
(intransitive) To become worthwhile; to produce a net benefit.
(idiomatic, of a job) To provide enough income to sustain one's lifestyle.
one to whom money is paid.
One who pays; specifically, the person by whom a bill or note has been, or should be, paid.
(uncountable) The act of paying.
A public telephone that requires prepayment to operate, generally via the insertion of coins or a credit card.
Abbreviation of piece.
(especially, when without a qualifier) A plant, Pisum sativum, member of the legume (Fabaceae) family.
Any of certain plants of the family Fabaceae: Pisum sativum and others.
(culinary) The edible seed of various other pea plants.
(culinary) The edible seed of Pisum sativum.
(nautical) A coat of heavy, navy-coloured wool, originally worn by sailors of European navies.
A medium green colour, like that of peas.
A state of tranquility, quiet, and harmony. For instance, a state free from civil disturbance.
Harmony in personal relations.
A state free of war, in particular war between different countries.
The absence of mental turmoil or anxiety.
A series of formal discussions between two or more nation-states or groups of people held to resolve existing conflict between them.
An agreement to end fighting or conflict.
Not at war; not disturbed by strife or turmoil.
Inclined to peace.
Motionless and calm.
(politics) A situation where nation-states do not interfere with the domestic affairs of other countries, in order to avoid conflict; mutual non-interference.
The act of preserving peace, specifically between hostile groups or states, especially by a sanctioned military force. [from 17th c.]
A person who restores peace, especially by settling disputes; one who engages in peacemaking.
The period of time when a nation or people is at peace, not fighting a war.
(countable) Any tree of species Prunus persica, native to China and now widely cultivated throughout temperate regions, having pink flowers and edible fruit.
(countable, uncountable) Soft juicy stone fruit of the peach tree, having yellow flesh, downy, red-tinted yellow skin, and a deeply sculptured pit or stone containing a single seed.
(uncountable) A light yellow-red colour.
(countable, informal) A particularly admirable or pleasing person or thing.
The flower of a peach tree that will eventually turn into a peach.
(literally) The fibrous material covering the skin of a peach fruit, e.g. as opposed to the fuzzless skin of a nectarine.
A South American palm tree with fleshy, edible fruit (Bactris gasipaes).
A peafowl (of the genus Pavo or Afropavo), either male or female.
(entomology) Any of various Asian species of papilionid butterflies of the genus Papilio.
Aglais io, a red butterfly with distinctive large eyespots, of the family Nymphalidae.
A female peafowl.
A point; the sharp end or top of anything that terminates in a point; as, the peak, or front, of a cap.
(geography) The top, or one of the tops, of a hill, mountain, or range, ending in a point.
(mathematics) A local maximum of a function, e.g. for sine waves, each point at which the value of y is at its maximum.
A loud sound, or a succession of loud sounds, as of bells, thunder, cannon, shouts, laughter, of a multitude, etc.
A legume resembling a nut, the fruit of the plant Arachis hypogaea, native to South America.
A spread made from ground peanuts.
(informal, figurative) Especially of a salary: a very insufficient or small amount.
A type of fruit tree (Pyrus communis).
A tree of the genus Pyrus, which bears the pears as fruits.

(literally) A shelly concretion, usually rounded, and having a brilliant luster, with varying tints, found in the mantle, or between the mantle and shell, of certain bivalve mollusks, especially in the pearl oysters and river mussels, and sometimes in certain univalves. It is usually due to a secretion of shelly substance around some irritating foreign particle. Its substance is the same as nacre, or mother-of-pearl. Round lustrous pearls are used in jewellery.
A pale grey colour, tinted with blue, like that of some pearls.
A widely grown millet (Cenchrus americanus, syn. Pennisetum glaucum).
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see pearl,‎ necklace.
(uncountable, uncommon, dated) A pale greyish white colour, tinted with blue.
Megastictus margaritatus, a passerine bird of the antbird family, native to South America.

A member of the lowly social class that toils on the land, constituted by small farmers and tenants, sharecroppers, farmhands and other laborers on the land where they form the main labor force in agriculture and horticulture.
A country person.
(historical) Impoverished rural farm workers, either as serfs, small freeholders or hired hands.
(weaponry, slang) Any small or ineffective gun or weapon.
Soil formed of dead but not fully decayed plants found in bog areas, often burned as fuel. [from 14th c.]
A small stone, especially one rounded by the action of water.
(computing) Strictly, 250 (10245, 1,125,899,906,842,624) bits or 210 (1024) tebibits, as opposed to a petabit.
(computing) Strictly, 250 (10245, 1,125,899,906,842,624) bytes or 210 (1024) tebibytes, as opposed to a petabyte.

sense.def: A smooth, thin-shelled, edible oval nut of this tree.
A sweet pie made from corn syrup and pecans, considered a specialty of Southern United States cuisine.
Any of the family Tayassuidae of mammals from the Americas, related to pigs.
To seize and pick up with the beak, or as if with the beak; to bite; to eat; often with up.

(carbohydrate) A polysaccharide extracted from the cell walls of plants, especially of fruits; under acidic conditions it forms a gel. It is often used in processed foods, especially jellies and jams where it causes thickening (setting).
(ichthyology) Either of two fins located on each side of a fish just behind the head.
Calidris melanotos, a small migratory wader that breeds in North America and Asia, wintering in South America and Oceania, and eats small invertebrates.
Out of the ordinary; odd; strange; unusual.
Common or usual for a certain place or circumstance; specific or particular.
Of, or relating to, money; monetary, financial.
The profession of teaching.
A lever operated by one's foot that is used to control or power a machine or mechanism, such as a bicycle or piano.
(UK, watercraft) A small boat propelled by pedals that directly turn external paddles, used for recreation.
A person who is overly concerned with formal rules and trivial points of learning.
Being overly concerned with formal rules and trivial points of learning, like a pedant.
Tending to show off one’s knowledge, often in a tiresome manner.
An itinerant seller of small goods.
(informal) A bicycle with an electric motor which assists the rider but only while they are pedalling.
A man who is engaged in an erotic relationship with an adolescent boy; a practitioner of pederasty.
Erotic love, sexually expressed or chaste, between a man and an adolescent boy.
(archaic) Anal intercourse in general, usually between a man and an adolescent boy.
(architecture) The base or foot of a column, statue, vase, lamp.
A walker; one who walks or goes on foot, especially as opposed to one who uses a vehicle.
A place where pedestrians are permitted to or advised to cross a street.
(American spelling) A physician that specializes in pediatrics; the medical care of infants, children, adolescents, and young adults.
(American spelling, medicine) The branch of medicine that deals with the treatment of children and adolescents.
A tricycle having a hooded cab to seat paying passengers.
A cosmetic treatment for the feet and toenails.
A chart, list, or record of ancestors, to show breeding, especially distinguished breeding. [from 15th c.]
(zootomy) Either of a second pair of appendages near the mouth of many arachnids, variously specialized as pincers, sensory or locomotory organs.
A device, often electronic, that measures the number of steps taken, and thus estimates the distance walked.
(psychiatry, sexology) An adult or older adolescent who is sexually attracted to prepubescent children. [from 20th c.]
(pejorative, by extension, common use) An adult who is sexually attracted to or engages in sexual acts with a child under the age of consent.
Sexual attraction by adults and adolescents to children, specifically prepubescent children.
(by extension, proscribed) Sexual activity between adults and children; the act of child molestation.

(uncountable) The technology that allows for the transmission of sound or other signals by modulation of electromagnetic waves.
(countable) A device that can transmit radio signals.
(countable) A device that can capture (receive) the signal sent over radio waves and render the modulated signal as sound.
The branch of astronomy which studies celestial bodies and occurrences at radio frequencies by means of radio telescopes.
(graphical user interface) Any of a group of widgets in a graphical user interface that is used to select one of a group of options; the selection of any one deselects the others.
A combination radio and cassette player.
A clock that is synchronized to a remote time standard by means of radio signals.
The use of radio signals to remotely control a device.
Dramatized, purely acoustic performance, broadcast on radio or published on audio media, such as tape or CD.
An installation of a radio transmitter, and possibly a receiver, for the purpose of broadcasting or communication.
(astronomy) A device for observing astronomical sources of radio waves, normally having one or more large parabolic dishes.
(physics) electromagnetic radiation having a wavelength between about .5 centimeters and 30,000 meters; used for the broadcasting of radio and television signals.
Controlled remotely using radio signals.
a model car controlled by radio waves from a battery-powered remote control unit.
Exhibiting radioactivity.
Waste containing radioactive nuclides.
Spontaneous emission of ionizing radiation as a consequence of a nuclear reaction, or directly from the breakdown of an unstable nucleus.
The radiation so emitted; including gamma rays, alpha particles, neutrons, electrons, positrons, etc.
An image, often a photographic negative, produced by radiation other than visible light; especially an X-ray photograph.
The process of making radiographs, and the science of analyzing them.
(physics) A radioactive isotope of an element.
A person who is skilled in or practices radiology.

(medicine) The specialty of medical imaging and its interpretation, originally and especially radiography#Noun but now including all imaging modalities, including ones that use no radiation#Noun (such as ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging).
(physics) a radioactive nuclide
(telegraphy, historical) A message, like a telegram, transmitted by wireless telegraphy.
A plant of the Brassicaceae family, Raphanus sativus or Raphanus raphanistrum subsp. sativus, having an edible root.
The chemical element (symbol Ra) with an atomic number of 88. It is a soft, shiny and silvery radioactive alkaline earth metal.
(zoology) The lighter bone (or fused portion of bone) in the forelimb of an animal.
(geometry) The length of this line segment.
(linguistics) A primitive word, from which other words may be derived.
(mathematics) The number of distinct symbols used to represent numbers in a particular base, as ten for decimal.
The chemical element (symbol Rn, formerly Ro) with atomic number 86. It is an odorless, colorless, chemically inert but radioactive noble gas.
A drawing, often held as a fundraiser, in which tickets or chances are sold to win a prize.

(botany) Any of several large parasitic plants, of the genus Rafflesia, from South East Asia, that have no roots, stems or leaves; Rafflesia arnoldii has the largest known flower with a diameter of over a yard.
A flat-bottomed craft able to float and drift on water, used for transport or as a waterborne platform.
(architecture) One of a series of sloped beams that extend from the ridge or hip to the downslope perimeter or eave, designed to support the roof deck and its associated loads.
The sport of guiding a raft while descending a river, especially through rapids known as white water rafting.
A piece of old cloth, especially one used for cleaning, patching, etc.; a tattered piece of cloth; a shred or tatter.
A doll made from cloth and stuffed with rags.
A modern American breed of domestic cat with a longhair colourpoint coat that relaxes completely when picked up.
Violent uncontrolled anger.
(intransitive) To act or speak in heightened anger.
(sometimes, figurative) To move with great violence, as a storm etc.
(intransitive, slang, video games) To quit an online video game in anger.
a stew of meat and vegetables mixed together

cit.quote: 無一文から大金持ちに

sense.def: (mostly, attributive) From poverty to exceptional wealth.
(ambitransitive, uncommon) To perform this style of music.
A plant of the genus Ambrosia. These weeds are particularly noted for producing pollen that triggers hay fever.
(law enforcement) An attack or invasion for the purpose of making arrests, seizing property, or plundering.
A horizontal bar extending between supports and used for support or as a barrier; a railing.
Any of several birds in the family Rallidae.
The metal bar forming part of the track for a railroad.
To complain violently (against, about).
(rail transport) A type of large nail with an offset head used to fasten a rail or base plate to a wooden railroad tie/sleeper.
An electromagnetic gun that uses a large electrical current to propel a projectile down a track of two parallel conductive rails.
(transitive) To transport via railroad.
(intransitive) To operate a railroad.
(intransitive) To engage in a hobby pertaining to railroads.
(transitive) To manipulate and hasten a procedure, as of formal approval of a law or resolution.
(US) Any railway vehicle or rolling stock.
(rail transport, US) A heavy, preserved piece of hewn timber laid crossways to and supporting the rails of a railroad or a member of similar shape and function of another material such as concrete.
(US, rail) A pair of formed steel rails, separated and supported usually on wooden or concrete ties or sleepers, forming a track along which flange-wheeled railroad vehicles may travel.
(chiefly, UK, Ireland, and, Commonwealth) A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.
(military) A massive and heavy mobile artillery gun, built, transported by, and fired from a specially designed rail car.
(British) A place where trains stop for passengers to embark and disembark.
(meteorology) Condensed water falling from a cloud.
(figuratively) Any matter moving or falling, usually through air, and especially if liquid or otherwise figuratively identifiable with raindrops.
(figuratively) An instance of particles or larger pieces of matter moving or falling through air.
(impersonal, meteorology) To have rain fall from the sky.
(transitive, figuratively) To issue (something) in large quantities.
(idiomatic, impersonal) To rain very heavily.
A cloud from which rain is falling or may fall.
(intransitive) To fall from the sky as, or like, rain.
(meteorology) A device used in meteorology to measure rainfall.
(figuratively) To disappoint or discourage someone by ruining or criticizing their plans or aspirations.
(weather) A short, mild period of rainfall.
Multicolored, especially if in rainbow order.
A multicoloured arch in the sky, produced by prismatic refraction of light within droplets of rain in the air.
(often used with “of”) A wide assortment; a varied multitude.
(usually, countable) A trout of the species Oncorhynchus mykiss, that has black spots and a pink streak running along the body.
A waterproof coat to be worn in the rain.
A single droplet of rainwater that has just fallen or is falling from the sky.
A dessert made with water and agar which resembles a drop of water, sometimes with fruit suspended inside (first popular in Japan circa 2014).
(meteorology) The amount of rain that falls on a single occasion
A storm characterized by substantial, heavy rainfall.
Water (for a house, etc.) sourced from rain which has not joined a spring, stream or river, pond, lake or sea.
Clothing worn as protection from rain.
Pouring with rain; wet; showery
The portion of the year during which the most rain falls.
To bring into being; to produce; to cause to arise, come forth, or appear.
A reason for being; the claimed reason for the existence of something or someone; the sole or ultimate purpose of something or someone.
A Hindu prince or ruler in India.

(agriculture, horticulture) A garden tool with a row of pointed teeth fixed to a long handle, used for collecting debris, grass, etc., for flattening the ground, or for loosening soil; also, a similar wheel-mounted tool drawn by a horse or a tractor.
(Hinduism) A member of a race of mythical fanged demons that eat human flesh and blood, somewhat like vampires.
A traditional distilled alcoholic beverage in Nepal and Tibet, usually homemade from kodo millet or rice.
A type of traditional Japanese comedic storytelling.

(medicine, now, chiefly, in plural) An abnormal clicking, rattling or crackling sound, made by one or both lungs and heard with a stethoscope, caused by the popping open of airways collapsed by fluid or exudate, or sometimes by pulmonary edema.
A public gathering or mass meeting that is not mainly a protest and is organized to inspire enthusiasm for a cause.
(squash, table tennis, tennis, badminton) A sequence of strokes between serving and scoring a point.
(motor racing) An event in which competitors drive through a series of timed special stages at intervals. The winner is the driver who completes all stages with the shortest cumulative time.
(zoology, agriculture) A male sheep, typically uncastrated.
(chiefly, US, informal) Boisterous, energetic, noisy, and difficult to control.
The fruit of this tree.
A cheese- or meat-based dish baked in a small mold.
Soup noodles of wheat, with various ingredients (Japanese-Chinese style).
(usually, countable) A tall, tropical Asian perennial herb, of species Boehmeria nivea, cultivated for its fibrous stems.

(aeronautics) A jet engine in which forward motion forces air into an inlet, compressing it (as opposed to having a pump type device compressing the air for combustion with fuel), and where combustion is subsonic.
An inclined surface that connects two levels; an incline.
(aviation) A mobile staircase that is attached to the doors of an aircraft at an airport.
A course of violent, frenzied action.
To move about wildly or violently.
A defensive mound of earth or a wall with a broad top and usually a stone parapet; a wall-like ridge of earth, stones or debris; an embankment for defensive purpose.
A defensive structure; a protective barrier; a bulwark.
In disrepair or disorder; poorly maintained; lacking upkeep, usually of buildings or vehicles.
A large plot of land used for raising cattle, sheep or other livestock.
A condiment made of buttermilk or sour cream, mayonnaise, minced green onion, garlic powder, and other seasonings mixed into a sauce.
The currency of South Africa, divided into 100 cents.
(statistics) Involving an outcome which is impossible to predict, but which may be represented by a probability distribution; in the ideal case, involving outcomes which are equally likely.
(computing) Pseudorandom; mimicking the result of random selection.
(informal) Being (part of) a varied, unrelated, and apparently arbitrary collection of things; diverse, heterogeneous.
(informal) Apropos of nothing; lacking context, relevance, or any connection to the previous situation; unexpected.
(informal) Of a person: characterized by or often saying random things; habitually using non sequiturs.
(figuratively, colloquial) An undefined, unknown or unimportant person; a person of no consequence. [from 20th c.]
A number selected based on a uniform distribution, typically using a suitable generator (for example, rolling a die).

A device or algorithm that generates numbers at random or apparently at random. In many cases they actually select successive numbers deterministically and are more technically termed pseudorandom number generator.
(statistics) A sample randomly taken from an investigated population.
(statistics, formally) A measurable function from a sample space to the measurable space of possible values of the variable.
(sports, baseball) The defensive area that a player can cover.
(music) The scale of all the tones a voice or an instrument can produce.
Any of several designs of optical (or other) instrument used to measure the distance to an object
A keeper, guardian, or soldier who ranges over a region (generally of wilderness) to protect the area or enforce the law.
Having a very strong and bad taste or odor.
The level of one's position in a class-based society.
A hierarchical level in an organization such as the military.
(idiomatic) The members of an organization, community, etc. who are not in leadership positions.
One’s relative placement in a list.
(computer security) Malware that holds the data of a computer user for ransom, usually requiring or claiming to require payment to restore access.
(music genre) Hip-hop music, especially when focused on rapping.

The act of forcing sex upon another person without their consent or against their will; originally coitus forced by a man on a woman, but now generally any sex act forced by any person upon another person; by extension, any non-consensual sex act forced on or perpetrated by any being. [from 15th c.]
(chiefly, transitive) To force sexual intercourse or other sexual activity upon (someone) without their consent. [from 16th c.]
The seed of the rape plant (Brassica napus), used widely for animal feed and vegetable oil.
A thick brownish-yellow oil expressed from rapeseed, used chiefly for cooking, lubricating and in the manufacture of soap and india rubber.
Very swift or quick.
A slender, straight, sharply pointed sword (double-edged, single-edged or edgeless), designed predominantly for thrusting; used during the Renaissance period of Europe for civilian duelling
One who has committed rape; someone who raped another person.
(music) A performer of rap music, or someone who raps in any form of music.
A relationship of mutual trust and respect; a close and harmonious relationship in which the people or groups concerned understand each other's feelings or ideas and communicate well.
The reestablishment of cordial relations, particularly between two countries; a reconciliation.
Very uncommon; scarce.
(cooking) Particularly of meat, especially beefsteak: cooked very lightly, so the meat is still red.
(chemistry) Any of the naturally occurring oxides of the lanthanide metals; they are widely distributed in relatively small concentrations and are used in glassmaking, ceramic glazes etc.
(chemistry) Any of a group of seventeen soft, lustrous, sometimes magnetic metals that form trivalent salts, which includes the lanthanides plus yttrium, scandium.
Not occurring at a regular interval; seldom; not often. [from 16th c.]
(pharmaceutical drug) An inhibitor of monoamine oxidase used as a monotherapy in early Parkinson's disease or as an adjunct therapy in more advanced cases.
Sometimes diminutive: a cheeky person or creature; a troublemaker.
A South Asian dessert made from chhena dumplings in a sugar syrup.

(dermatology, symptom) An area of inflamed and irritated skin characterized by reddened spots that may be filled with fluid or pus. Also, preceded by a descriptive word (rare, or, obsolete) , an illness characterized by a type of rash.
A coarse file or filelike tool, on which the cutting prominences are distinct points raised by the oblique stroke of a sharp punch, instead of lines raised by a chisel, as on the true file.
The plant Rubus idaeus.
The juicy aggregate fruit of these plants.
A red colour, the colour of a ripe raspberry.
A soup in Russian cuisine made from pickled cucumbers.
(zoology) A medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus.
The proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another. [from 15th c.]
The price of (an individual) thing; cost. [from 16th c.]
The relative speed of change or progress. [from 18th c.]
A set price or charge for all examples of a given case, commodity, service etc. [from 16th c.]
A wage calculated in relation to a unit of time.
Any of various taxes, especially those levied by a local authority. [from 17th c.]
(horology) The gain or loss of a timepiece in a unit of time.
Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than) [from 9th c.]
(conjunctive) Used to introduce a contradiction; on the contrary. [from 14th c.]
(degree) Somewhat, quite; to an unexpected degree. [from 16th c.]
A formal declaration of agreement to a treaty etc.
(transitive) To give formal consent to; make officially valid, sign off on.
An evaluation of status, especially of financial status.
A number representing a comparison between two named things.
(transitive) To portion out (especially during a shortage of supply); to limit access to.
Logically sound; not self-contradictory or otherwise absurd.
(algebra) Of an algebraic expression in indeterminates, or more generally a function: capable of being expressed as the ratio of two polynomials.
(arithmetic) Of a number, capable of being expressed as the ratio of two integers.
(mathematics) A number that can be expressed as the ratio of two integers.
A baby’s toy designed to make sound when shaken, usually containing loose grains or pellets in a hollow container. [from 16th c.]
Rattling sound.
Any of various venomous American snakes, of genera Crotalus and Sistrurus, having a rattle at the end of its tail.
Botrypus virginianus, a low-growing ternately branched herb in the Ophioglossales.
Briza maxima, a species of grass.
A device (trap) used to catch rats.
An all-night dance party with electronic dance music (techno, trance, drum and bass etc.) in small unknown clubs.
(countable) Any of several, generally large and lustrous black species of birds in the genus Corvus, especially the common raven (Corvus corax).
Having hair that is very black and lustrous.
A deep narrow valley or gorge in the earth's surface worn by running water.
Small square parcels of pasta filled with meat, cheese, spinach etc.
(cooking) (of food) Not cooked. [from 9th c.]
(data management, statistics) Data that has not been analyzed or processed.
A material in its unprocessed, natural state considered usable for manufacture.
(UK, dialectal, chiefly, Scotland, intransitive) To stretch after sleep.
Any of the superorder Batoidea of marine fish with flat bodies, large wing-like fins, and whip-like tails.
(botany) A radiating part of a flower or plant; the marginal florets of a compound flower, such as an aster or a sunflower; one of the pedicels of an umbel or other circular flower cluster; radius.
A manufactured regenerated cellulosic fiber.
A keen-edged knife of peculiar shape, used in shaving the hair from the face or other parts of the body.
Any tool or instrument designed for shaving.
A replaceable cartridge in which razor blades are set, fitted into a razor.
A clam of several species in superfamily Solenoidea, with long curved shells resembling straight razors.
A form of securing wire similar to barbed wire, but with a series of short blades instead of barbs. Also, a length thereof.
(music) A syllable used in solfège to represent the second note of a major scale.
About, regarding, with reference to; especially in letters, documents, emails and case law.
again, anew
The power of stretching out or extending action, influence, or the like; power of attainment or management; extent of force or capacity.
(boxing) The distance a boxer's arm can extend to land a blow.
(transitive) To give to someone by stretching out a limb, especially the hand; to give with the hand; to pass to another person; to hand over.
(transitive, by extension) To extend an action, effort, or influence to; to penetrate to; to pierce, or cut.
(transitive) To extend to; to stretch out as far as; to touch by virtue of extent.
(transitive, figurative) To connect with (someone) on an emotional level, making them receptive of (one); to get through to (someone).
(chemistry, intransitive) To act upon each other; to exercise a reciprocal or a reverse effect, as two or more chemical agents; to act in opposition.
(chemistry, transitive) To cause chemical agents to react; to cause one chemical agent to react with another.
(physics, electrics) The opposition to the change in flow of current in an alternating current circuit, due to inductance and capacitance; the imaginary part of the impedance. Symbol: X.
(chemistry) Any of the participants present at the start of a chemical reaction, specifically one that is consumed during the reaction.
An action or statement in response to a stimulus or other event.
(chemistry) A transformation in which one or more substances is converted into another by combination or decomposition.
(politics) Extremely conservative; opposing revolution (such as the French Revolution); favoring a return to a golden age of the past.
(politics) One who opposes revolution, wanting to reverse it, favoring a return to a past golden age. Often used as a derogatory by revolutionaires.
(nuclear physics) A device which uses atomic energy to produce heat.
(transitive, or, intransitive) To look at and interpret letters or other information that is written.
(transitive, or, intransitive) To speak aloud words or other information that is written. (often construed with a to phrase or an indirect object)
(transitive) To interpret, or infer a meaning, significance, thought, intention, etc., from.
(go) To imagine sequences of potential moves and responses without actually placing stones.
(idiomatic) To infer a meaning that is not stated explicitly.
(computing) Unalterable, capable of being read but not written.
(computing) A computer memory chip that stores values but does not allow updates, in which the values are nonvolatile in that they are retained even when the computer is unpowered.
A person who reads a publication.
The process of interpreting written language.
(go, uncountable) The act or process of imagining sequences of potential moves and responses without actually placing stones.
Anything produced for the purpose of being read; a collective term for books, magazines, newspapers, etc.; reading matter.
A dedicated space in a library, or similar institution of learning, set aside for reading.
Prepared for immediate action or use.
(sports) On your mark, get set, go.
(chemistry) A compound or mixture of compounds used to treat or test materials, samples, other compounds or reactants in a laboratory or sometimes an industrial setting.
True, genuine, not merely nominal or apparent.
Genuine, not artificial, counterfeit, or fake.
Genuine, unfeigned, sincere.
That has objective, physical existence.
(economics) Having been adjusted to remove the effects of inflation; measured in purchasing power (contrast nominal).
(economics) Relating to the result of the actions of rational agents; relating to neoclassical economic models as opposed to Keynesian models.

(mathematics, of a number) Being either a rational number, or the limit of a convergent infinite sequence of rational numbers: being one of a set of numbers with a one-to-one correspondence to the points on a line.
(legal) Relating to immovable tangible property.
Absolute, complete, utter.
Former unit of currency of Spain and Spain's colonies.
(uncountable) A unit of currency used in Brazil since 1994. Symbol: R$.
A commodity; see realty.
(mathematics) The branch of mathematics dealing with the real numbers and related structures.
(mathematics) The horizontal line in the complex plane, every point on which corresponds to a real number
(US, Canada, Australia) Property that cannot easily be moved, usually buildings and the ground on which they are built.
Life outside of a contrived or fantastical environment; often used in comparison to events depicted in drama.

(mathematics) The limit of a convergent sequence of rational numbers, whether the limit is a rational number such as 2, -5, or 2/7 or whether the limit is an irrational number such as the square root of two or the circumference of the circle whose radius is one.
(complex analysis) Of a complex number a + bi, the value a.
pragmatic socialism, practical socialism, a form of socialism which attempts to reach tangible goals perceived to be feasible instead of primarily focusing on adherence to Marxist-Leninist theory.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see real,‎ time.

(computing) Of a system: that responds to events or signals within a predictable time after their occurrence; specifically the response time must be within the maximum allowed, but is typically synchronous.
(mineral) A mineral, arsenic sulfide (AsS), often associated with orpiment and stibnite in lead, silver and gold ores.
A concern for fact or reality and rejection of the impractical and visionary.
Expressed or represented as being accurate, practicable, or not idealistic.
The state of being actual or real; realness.
A real entity, event, or other fact.
The entirety of all that is real.
An individual observer's own subjective perception of that which is real.

(psychology, psychoanalysis, Freudianism) The mental mechanism which guides a person, as he or she matures, in adapting to and coping with the real, external world, by suppressing or deferring the childish gratification-seeking desires of the id.
A reality television program.
(television) A genre of television programming portraying one or more people who are not professional actors and depicting their reactions to given stimuli or goals.
The act of making real.
(chiefly, passive voice, slightly, _, formal) To convert (something imaginary or planned, as a goal or idea) into reality; to bring into real existence, to make real. [from early 17th c.]
(modal) Actually; in fact; in reality.
(informal, as an intensifier) Very (modifying an adjective); very much (modifying a verb).
(informal) Indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information; to express skepticism.
(archaic, or, legal, &, rhetoric) A territory or state, as ruled by an absolute authority, especially by a king; a kingdom. [from ca. 1300]
(politics) Pragmatic, often expansionist, diplomacy and politics focused on perceived national interests of the state to the near exclusion of ethical, moral, and theoretical objectives.
(North America) A person or business that sells or leases out real estate, acting as an agent for the property owner.
(ambitransitive) To restore (someone or something) to animation or life; to come back to animation or life.
(transitive) To cut (for example a grain) with a sickle, scythe, or reaping machine
(intransitive, idiomatic) To receive as a return or reward in the same measure as one's exertions or intentions, in a good or a bad sense; to receive justice or one's just deserts.
Being behind, or in the hindmost part; hindmost..
The back or hindmost part; that which is behind, or last in order.
(military) Specifically, the part of an army or fleet which comes last, or is stationed behind the rest.
(transitive) To bring up to maturity, as offspring; to educate; to instruct; to foster.
(intransitive) To rise up on the hind legs.
(transitive, literary) To raise physically or metaphorically; to lift up; to cause to rise, to elevate.
One who operates the gun in the rear turret of a bomber.
A mirror inside a vehicle that allows the driver to see the traffic behind.
The process of rearming.
An excuse: a thought or a consideration offered in support of a determination or an opinion; that which is offered or accepted as an explanation.
That which causes something: an efficient cause, a proximate cause.
(uncountable) Rational thinking (or the capacity for it); the cognitive faculties, collectively, of conception, judgment, deduction and intuition.

(legal) A fictional person used as a comparative legal standard to represent an average member of society and how he or she would behave or think, especially in determining negligence; sometimes formulated as "a person of ordinary prudence exercising due care in like circumstances."
(uncountable) The deduction of inferences or interpretations from premises, abstract thought, ratiocination; (countable) any instance of this, especially as a process leading to an action, motive.
That reassures; causing or restoring comfort or confidence.
(countable) A steel reinforcing bar in a reinforced concrete structure.
(Judaism) The spiritual leader of a Hasidic Jewish community.
A person who resists an established authority, often violently.
(intransitive) To resist or become defiant toward an authority.
(uncountable) Armed resistance to an established government or ruler.
(countable) Defiance of authority or control; the act of rebelling.
Showing rebellion.
Reincarnation; new birth subsequent to one's first.
Revival, reinvigoration.
Spiritual renewal.
(computing) An instance of rebooting.
(computing, ergative) To execute a computer's boot process, effectively resetting the computer and causing the operating system to reload, commonly after a system failure.
Revived or regenerated, especially emotionally or spiritually.
(often, _, postpositive) Reincarnated.
(basketball) An instance of catching the ball after it has hit the rim or backboard without a basket being scored, generally credited to a particular player.
retransmission, a repeated or relayed broadcast
To broadcast again.
(ambitransitive) To build again or anew.
(of a person) To criticise harshly; to reprove.
An arrangement of pictures, symbols, and/or words representing phrases or words, especially as a word puzzle.
To deny the truth of something, especially by presenting arguments that disprove it.
The act of contradicting something by making a contrary argument, or presenting contrary evidence.
(transitive) To call back, bring back, or summon (someone) to a specific place, station, etc. [from 16th c.]
(transitive) To call back (a situation, event, etc.) to one's mind; to remember; to recollect. [from 16th c.]
(ambitransitive) To summarize or repeat in concise form.
(theology) The symmetry provided by Christ's life to the teachings of the Old Testament; the summation of human experience in Jesus Christ.
To move back; to retreat; to withdraw.
The act of receiving, or the fact of having been received.
A written acknowledgment that a specified article or sum of money has been received.
(transitive, dated) To take, as something that is offered; to accept.
(sports) To be in a position to take possession, or hit back the ball.
A person who receives.
Any of several electronic devices that receive electromagnetic waves, or signals transmitted as such. [from 19th c.]
The part of a telephone handset contained in the earpiece; (hence) the handset itself; an earpiece. [from 19th c.]
(legal, business) A form trusteeship of bankruptcy administration in which a receiver is appointed to run the company for the benefit of the creditors.
Having happened a short while ago.
(referring to a time period starting in the recent past and including the present) in recent times.
A container.
(botany) The part of the flower stalk (peduncle or pedicel) to which the floral parts are attached; a thalamus, a torus.
(electricity, US) A contact device installed at an outlet for the connection of an attachment plug (typically by receiving the plug's prongs) to supply portable appliances or equipment.
The act of receiving.
(uncountable, electronics) The act or ability to receive radio or similar signals.
A social engagement, usually to formally welcome someone.
The desk of a hotel or office where guests are received.

(linguistics) Reading viewed as the active process of receiving a text in any medium (written, spoken, signed, multimodal, nonverbal), consisting of several steps, such as ideation, comprehension, reconstruction, interpretation.
An employee (such as a secretary) who works in reception (receiving visitors and/or calls) for a person or business, especially an office.
(countable) A depressed, hollow, or indented space; also, a hole or opening.
(Australia, Britain, North America, Philippines, education) A time away from studying during the school day for a meal or recreation.
(countable) A temporary stoppage of an activity; a break, a pause.
(countable) An act of retiring or withdrawing from public life, society, etc.; also, an act of living in retirement or seclusion, or a period of such retirement or seclusion.
Of an official body: to suspend proceedings for a period of time.
(economics) A period of reduced economic activity
(genetics) Able to be masked by a dominant allele or trait.
Committing new offenses after a crime committed in the past.
Now especially, a set of instructions for making or preparing food dishes. [from 18th c.]
One who receives.
(medicine) A person receiving donor organs or tissues.
(arithmetic) The number obtained by dividing 1 by another given number; the result of exchanging the numerator and the denominator of a fraction.
(transitive) To exchange two things, with both parties giving one thing and taking another thing.
A vocal, instrumental or visual performance by a soloist.
The act of publicly reciting something previously memorized.
(transitive) To repeat aloud (some passage, poem or other text previously memorized, or in front of one's eyes), often before an audience.
Careless or heedless; headstrong or rash.
